summary: CVE-2026-93519 affecting package xorg-x11-server-Xwayland for versions less than 24.1.14-1
details: A buffer overflow when handling pointer barriers in the XFIXES extension in X.Org X server before 21.1.25 and XWayland before 24.1.14 could be used by authenticated X clients to crash or potentially execute code in X server context.
